Heh... good question... well, first of all, Manyland offers a lot of freedom. It's also self-maintained, so if everyone helps, the world becomes better... it really depends on all of us. We have flag reporting you can do based on areas, creations and more, and we're all trying to keep the world in good shape (if a newcomer bundles up on flag reports, it may cause some warnings to be sent to them at first). Also for instance, in a shared area, if a block by a certain rank is placed a certain length of time, and then removed, it leaves undo dust for some days, so the next person along can repair or check what happened (you can also create an area where you can determine who can edit and place things). But since offensiveness is often in the eyes of the beholder, sometimes it's more about finding the right location where people enjoy what you're doing, more than trying to please everyone in Manyland.
